brief.aim: The table is the canonical Cleveland angiography cohort assembled to predict angiographic heart-disease presence, and heart_disease_binary already encodes that presence/absence outcome, so binary classification on it is the evident task. The raw severity column num is the source from which the binary label was derived and would leak the answer, so it is excluded from features and listed as a leakage suspect.
brief.repeated_subjects: None; each row is a distinct patient examination with no subject key repeating across rows
brief.unit: One patient examination record (single clinical entry of one individual at Cleveland)
